data.body: AC amendment (gap analysis 2/6): Add CONFIG_WRITE_LOG mechanism for partial-state-recovery ordering test. t_config_keys_written_early cannot observe write-vs-aws-call interleaving by inspecting only the final config file. Add CONFIG_WRITE_LOG env override; write_config_key appends 'WROTE <key>' to ${CONFIG_WRITE_LOG:-/dev/null}; merge CALL_LOG + CONFIG_WRITE_LOG by line-number to assert ordering. Mirror task-2: write_config_key uses ${CONFIG_WRITE_LOG:-/dev/null} indirection.
